current_local_stage: Verify accessible duplicate file bytes before browser storage upload and require existing document-specific view permission.
Fingerprint actual caller-readable stored bytes during registration and reject inconsistent client fingerprints.
Probe exact storage_path across row visibility before reading/scanning/registering; reject referenced or uncertain paths without exposing row identity.

next_database_design_requirements: Prepare a reviewed durable upload-attempt reservation binding authenticated actor, student, exact new object path, verified fingerprint and immutable review context. Preserve explicit student access and partner restrictions.

Enforce exclusive document path ownership, including hidden/archived/deleted references. Inventory legacy collisions first; migration must stop for review rather than silently rewrite/delete existing records.
Coordinate simultaneous identical-content attempts per student without merging students, sharing grants, document ownership or quarantined/retired status. Never revive a blocked file implicitly.

Prove the uploaded object belongs to the reserved attempt and prevent direct document writes/finalization from bypassing that boundary. Review storage write/read policies and grant inventory together.

Use atomic database claim/finalize/cleanup state transitions so a losing/expired attempt cannot finalize while its object is being reconciled. A SELECT-then-delete or browser in-flight flag is insufficient.

Only consider exact manifest paths/IDs for cleanup after proving no document, live attempt, summary job, evidence/source or retention reference can claim them. Storage deletion requires its own confirmed receipt and independent exact absence check.
Preserve required audit retention; never delete unrelated or prefix-matched rows/objects to obtain zero counts. Stop on ambiguous ownership, references, processing or completion.

Prevent object mutation between fingerprint, sniff, scan and enqueue; bind processing to a verified immutable object version or equivalent bytes. Current separate downloads are not an atomic storage snapshot.

Review the new scan-state proposal restricting direct client scan/review-status writes and freezing uploader identity. Trusted service writes and legacy clean rows are not scan provenance or immutable-byte proof; retain actual provider/ownership verification.
